description:
• Brand introduction: 

At Noble King, we believe that a great shaving routine is more than just a grooming necessity - it's a timeless tradition that connects generations. With our luxury shaving kit, we've combined the best of old-world craftsmanship with modern design to create a product that will last through generations.


• Product description:

Our kit includes a Silvertip Badger Hair Brush with a beautifully crafted mahogany wood handle and a stainless steel bottom. The brush is designed to create a rich, luxurious lather and provide a comfortable and close shave. The mahogany wood used in our kit is carefully polished and finished to perfection, setting the tone for the attention to detail that goes into each product. We also include a safety razor with a stunning mahogany wood and stainless steel finish. Our razors are designed to provide a smooth and comfortable shave, ensuring a close and precise cut every time. We know that a good razor is a crucial part of any shaving routine, and our product is no exception. To keep your brush and razor safe and organized, we've included a stainless steel holder that is both functional and stylish. The holder will keep your grooming tools in place and prevent them from getting damaged, ensuring they last for years to come. But that's not all. We know that travel is an important part of modern life, so we've included a genuine leather dopp kit to store your shaving kit. The dopp kit is designed to keep your grooming tools safe and secure, with insert slots that hold everything in place during transit. The dopp kit also has plenty of space for other toiletries, making it the perfect travel companion whether you're going on vacation, to the gym, or the country club. To complete the kit, we've included our Noble King sandalwood shaving soap. • USP (Unique Selling Point): This is one of the few luxury shaving kit that inlcudes a unique travel bag specifically designed to carry and protect your shaving kit.  It is a complete set that includes shaving soap, razors, stand, safety razor, shaving brush and travel bag. 
• Payment terms: 15% of Sale
• Other information:  Silvertip badger hair is widely know as the gold standard of shaving brushes.  It is know for it's softness and it's water retention properties.  Our target demographic is men ages 55-65+.
